text:
Ravi (Product): Quick capture from the all-hands Q&A. Folks want explicit milestone clarity for API GA, Console beta, and Optimize alpha. Also asked about canary sizes and default fallback behavior.

Dana (CEO): Timeline anchors: API GA target 2027-05-05, Console beta target 2027-07-20, Optimize alpha target 2027-09-01. We'll confirm after next week's risk review. These are not final but good for planning.

Iris (ENG-Platform): Canary proposal: progressive rollout starting 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 14 days, auto-rollback on error rate jump >4% or p95 latency increase >25%. Example snippet below.

```
canary:
  stages: [1,5,20]
  stage_duration_days: [3,7,4]
  rollback_criteria:
    error_rate_pct_increase: 4
    p95_latency_increase_pct: 25
```

Omar (SRE): SLO suggestion: classify requests as short/long. Short p95 < 180ms, long p95 < 800ms, GA availability 99.9%. Need Product to map endpoints to classes. Also propose a fallback order: quantized variant -> reduced max_tokens -> region failover.

Tess (DevEx): Console beta will ship core UX: model catalog, rollout panel, and cost insights. Optimize alpha should include batching hints and quant profiles; automated evals to be deferred to v1. UX must emphasize opt-in.

Ravi (Product): Action items: publish dates to roadmap doc by Tue; Iris to post canary YAML and playbook by Wed; Omar to draft SLOs and runbooks by Wed; Tess to share Console beta feature list by Thu.

Iris (ENG-Platform): Ack. I'll include metrics dashboard templates.

Omar (SRE): Ack. Will add incident steps for rollback.

Tess (DevEx): Ack. Will draft customer-facing copy for Console beta and Optimize opt-in.

ops-bot: Canary deployment `canary-small-269114` started, image `rwd/serve:canary-2027-04-21`.

Dana (CEO): Thanks everyone. Make sure Sales and Partner teams get a heads-up after dates are finalized.

Ravi (Product): Thanks team 44d
